title: Lifelong Opportunity Guides: Multilingual Career and Education Guide Library
description: A free multilingual library of 101 practical career and education guides, numbered 00 through 100, created and directed by Alberto "Al" Leiva. The 2026 controlled revision is complete: all 101 guides are closed through Publication PASS and Release Audit PASS under the project's evidence-supported release standard, with zero final blockers and 303 controlled PDF edition links validated across English, neutral Latin American Spanish, and Brazilian Portuguese. The collection supports students, career changers, older adults, people with disabilities, workers seeking advancement, families, and community organizations with plain-language career pathways, free-first learning options, accessibility guidance, responsible-AI guidance, and verification through current official sources.
